Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder must submit affidavit for non blacklisting from any govt. agencies or institution on 200rs Stamp a nd submit hardcopy of it in office before opening the bid.

2. Bidder must submit MII Certifacte. 3. An emd for 15000rs. is needed in name of District Manager MP State Agro Industries Development Corp oration Limited katni. 4. EMD exemption is not excepted. 5. Bidder must submit hardcopy of emd before opening the bid. 6. Bidder must have experince in Gym Category. 7.GST, PAN ,Aadhar card, Company registration is needed. 8. EN Certificate, GMP, CE, Welding procedure test Certificate is needed. 9.ISO, EMS and TQM Certificate is needed. 10. Bidder must submit sample before opening the bid at District Manager Office . 11. Material Test Report is mandatory for Bidder. 12. ZED Certificate issued by MSME is mandatory. 13. Bidder must have local service centre in nearby location at min 100km distance .
